name: ARCTEXT
description: Create linked text on one selected circular arc: "text" [HEIGHT metres] [OFFSET metres] [SPACING metres] [ALIGN START|CENTER|END] [DIRECTION FORWARD|REVERSE]. Without selection, pick an arc using a point action. EDIT "text" with the same options edits a selected label; DETACH keeps independent editable arc text. Source edits refresh labels in the same undo step. Independent label transforms detach; paired similarity transforms retain linkage. Model space only.

name: HYPERLINK
description: Object web links in model space: SET "https://host/path" ["label"] adds/replaces a link on the selected editable objects; REMOVE removes links, each as one undo step. OPEN opens the single selected object link in the default browser without drawing edits. No arguments shows the selected object link fields. HTTP/HTTPS only, no credentials, URLs up to 4096 characters and labels up to 256. Metadata persists through drawing normalization and archives.

name: ALIASEDIT
description: Personal command aliases persisted in application settings, outside drawing undo. No arguments opens settings. SET alias command creates or replaces a personal alias; REMOVE alias removes one. Built-in names/aliases, invalid targets and duplicate aliases are refused. Personal aliases expand only the command token and preserve arguments. They apply to the command bar and MCP command entry.

name: PNGOUT
description: Export the visible model through the shared scene renderer. [WIDTH 64..4096] [BACKGROUND #rrggbb|TRANSPARENT] [TO absolute/path]. JPEG requires an opaque background and accepts QUALITY 0.1..1. Defaults: width 2048, PNG/SVG transparent, JPEG white and quality .92. Native atomic save or browser download; no drawing/history change. SVG retains vector geometry and editable text; cached underlays/images remain raster.

name: JPGOUT
description: Export the visible model through the shared scene renderer. [WIDTH 64..4096] [BACKGROUND #rrggbb|TRANSPARENT] [TO absolute/path]. JPEG requires an opaque background and accepts QUALITY 0.1..1. Defaults: width 2048, PNG/SVG transparent, JPEG white and quality .92. Native atomic save or browser download; no drawing/history change. SVG retains vector geometry and editable text; cached underlays/images remain raster.

name: SVGOUT
description: Export the visible model through the shared scene renderer. [WIDTH 64..4096] [BACKGROUND #rrggbb|TRANSPARENT] [TO absolute/path]. JPEG requires an opaque background and accepts QUALITY 0.1..1. Defaults: width 2048, PNG/SVG transparent, JPEG white and quality .92. Native atomic save or browser download; no drawing/history change. SVG retains vector geometry and editable text; cached underlays/images remain raster.

name: DGNATTACH
description: Attach supported 2D V7 DGN as a portable vector reference with embedded source. Syntax: [absolute.dgn] [UNIT mm|cm|m|km|in|ft|yd|us-ft] [AT x y] [SCALE factor]. Omit path for native/browser picker. Same geometry support and warnings as DGNIMPORT, source limited to 25 MiB. No automatic external reads. One undo step; context changes and invalid geometry refuse atomically.

name: DGNCLIP
description: Clip one selected editable DGN reference: ON, OFF, DELETE, RECT x1 y1 x2 y2 or POLYGON x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3 [...]. Coordinates are local metres; one undo step.

name: DGNIMPORT
description: Import supported 2D DGN V7 geometry with one undo entry: [absolute.dgn] [UNIT mm|cm|m|km|in|ft|yd|us-ft] [AT x y] [SCALE factor] [CELLS BLOCKS|EXPLODE]. Omit path for native/browser picker. UNIT overrides ambiguous source labels; position is metres. Lines, polylines, closed shapes, ellipses/arcs and solid fills become editable geometry, with source levels and graphic groups. Connected complex chains/shapes (including nested open chains) with uniform level/group retain exact parts, member colors/weights/styles and header fills; member database links/locks produce omission warnings. Printable ASCII text imports as editable text with substitute-font/metric warnings. Unknown graphic records, other text encodings, nested closed shapes or differing member levels/groups, unsupported linkages, 3D and V8 reject atomically. Cells become linked block instances by default, retaining nested definitions, source order, levels and insertion origins. CELLS EXPLODE keeps independent editable groups plus reusable definitions. Each source cell has its own collision-safe definition; metadata omissions are reported. Selection groups map to containing model instances. Grouped holes with one closed solid and disjoint internal holes retain exact hatch boundaries and editable outlines; outside/touching/crossing/nested holes and multiple solids reject atomically. Approximate stroke styles and omitted non-geometric metadata/locks are reported. Model space only, outside block editing.

name: DWFATTACH
description: Attach a supported DWFx page as a portable underlay with source bytes and PNG preview. Syntax: [absolute.dwfx] [PAGE n] [AT x y] [SCALE factor]. Default page 1, origin 0 0, scale 1; dimensions are metres. Omit path for picker. One undo step; context changes and unsupported XPS visuals reject without partial edits. Current reader supports compatible paths, solid/gradient brushes and PNG images; glyphs and legacy DWF6 are not yet supported.

name: DWFCLIP
description: Crop one selected editable DWFx underlay using shared block clipping. OFF, ON, DELETE, RECT x1 y1 x2 y2 or POLYGON x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3 [...]. Coordinates are local to the underlay; one undo step.

name: WMFOUT
description: Export visible model-space geometry to a WMF file without changing the drawing or history. Syntax: [absolute.wmf] [RASTER [WIDTH 64..4096] [BACKGROUND #RRGGBB]]. Explicit RASTER uses the editor scene to composite the complete visible drawing on an opaque background (default white, width 2048, bounded to 4096 pixels per side and 16 million pixels); objects become one bitmap. Omit the path for native Save As or browser download. Exports supported curves, solid/pattern fills, nested blocks and cached loaded drawing references and supported cached PDF previews with rectangular clip intersections, supported dimension lines/arrows/localized labels, compatible text and opaque embedded raster images with axis-aligned placement, quarter-turn rotations, rectangular clips and appearance adjustments. Reports coordinate/stroke/font approximations and local export origin. Oblique/polygon-clipped images and binary transparency use bounded colored pixel regions with a smoothing warning. In the default vector mode, partial transparency, gradients, nonrectangular block clips or complex text reject the whole export.

name: WMFIN
description: Import WMF vector geometry into model space with one undo entry. Syntax: [absolute.wmf] [AT x y] [SCALE positiveFactor]. Omit path for file picker; browser requires picker. Coordinates are metres. Supported records cover lines, polygons, compound fills, rectangles, ellipses, elliptical arcs/chords/pie sectors, pens/brushes and mapping state. Unsupported records reject the entire import. Appearance approximations are reported. Supported text, embedded DIB copies and rectangular clipping import with explicit fidelity warnings; remaining record variants reject atomically.

name: DXFIN
description: Import 2D model geometry from an ASCII DXF file in one undo step. Syntax: [absolute path] [UNIT mm|cm|m|km|in|ft|yd|us-ft] [AT x y] [SCALE factor] [SKIP]. Omit the path for the native/browser picker. UNIT overrides $INSUNITS and is required for unitless files. Lines, points, circles, arcs, ellipses, polylines with bulges, cubic splines, basic text and static blocks become editable objects on collision-safe layers. Paper-space objects are ignored and counted. Unsupported model objects (hatches, dimensions, 3D…) refuse the whole import and are listed by DXF type; SKIP imports everything else and reports what was left out.

name: DXFOUT
description: Export model-space geometry to an ASCII DXF file in metres without editing the document. Syntax: [absolute path]. Omit the path for the native picker or a browser download. Unsupported entities refuse the entire export. Layouts and advanced metadata are not exported; appearance and text approximations are reported.

name: DWGIN
description: Import 2D model geometry from a DWG file in one undo step. LibreDWG dwgread converts it to DXF, then DXFIN rules apply, including SKIP. Syntax: [absolute path] [UNIT mm|cm|m|km|in|ft|yd|us-ft] [AT x y] [SCALE factor] [SKIP]. Desktop only; requires LibreDWG on PATH, in LUMCAD_LIBREDWG_DIR or a standard install directory.

name: DWGOUT
description: Export model-space geometry to an experimental R2000 DWG file without editing the document. LUMCAD writes the DXFOUT subset and LibreDWG dwgwrite converts it. Syntax: [absolute path]. Desktop only; requires LibreDWG on PATH, in LUMCAD_LIBREDWG_DIR or a standard install directory. AutoCAD compatibility is not guaranteed.

name: ETRANSMIT
description: Package the open sheet set and every declared source plus recursive drawing/CSV dependencies as a portable ZIP: optional absolute/output.zip, otherwise native Save As. Rewrites paths in copies only, retains embedded assets and cached geometry/cells, refuses missing/replaced dependencies. Desktop only. No upload or sending is performed.

name: NEWSHEETSET
description: Create a separate project sheet index: quoted name. Refuses replacing unsaved sheet-set edits. Does not change the active drawing.

name: OPENSHEETSET
description: Open a LUMCAD sheet-set JSON index via picker or explicit absolute path (desktop). Refuses replacing unsaved sheet-set edits. Does not open or modify source drawings.

name: SHEETSET
description: REPORT shows ordered sheets in Measurements and editor.sheetSet. SAVE [absolute/path.json] writes the index; changed directories preserve original source locations. ADD CURRENT|absolute/file.lcad layoutNameOrId number title adds a sheet from a saved source (desktop). REMOVE index, NUMBER index value, TITLE index value, ORDER indices, PROPERTY PROJECT|ALL|index key value edit the set; indices are one-based report positions. UNDO/REDO apply only to sheet-set edits. SAVE clears this separate history. CHECK validates every used source identity/layout without publishing. CLOSE refuses unsaved edits; CLOSE DISCARD explicitly discards them. The active set survives drawing-session changes but not application restart; save it explicitly. PUBLISH PDF|DWFX [absolute/output path] preflights saved sources and publishes every sheet in report order with individual paper/plot settings. Transmittal remains in development. INVENTORY checks the complete recursive transmittal snapshot without writing a file and exposes file paths, kinds, sizes and collection failures in editor.sheetSet.transmittal.

name: STANDARDS
description: SAVE [absolute/file.json] exports current layer and style definitions. LOAD [absolute/file.json] reads a portable LUMCAD standards JSON file (picker when omitted). REPORT checks the active drawing; DETACH removes the drawing association. LOAD and DETACH are undoable. Model space only, outside BEDIT. The source snapshot is embedded in .lcad and restored without automatic source-file access. JSON format lumcad-standards version 1; this does not parse Autodesk DWS files.

name: CHECKSTANDARDS
description: Check the embedded drawing standards and show numbered issues in Measurements and editor.standards. FIX ALL or FIX followed by one-based issue numbers repairs properties/adds missing definitions atomically with undo. Stale issues and locked dimension changes reject. REPLACE issueNumber "approved name" explicitly merges/renames a nonstandard definition onto an approved target; built-in definitions are protected. Existing target IDs are reused, absent targets retain source IDs, and layer filters/viewport references follow the replacement. Explicit dimension overrides remain. Style presets for tables/leaders/multilines update their catalogs, not independent entity snapshots.

name: COMPAREIMPORT
description: Import ALL differences or a space-separated list of one-based change numbers from the last COMPARE snapshot. One whole-document undo step includes model/layout/catalog/name/asset changes. Refuses stale targets, locked model objects and incomplete dependency/order selections without partial import. Unrelated local edits are retained. No source file is written. Snapshot numbering stays unchanged until a new COMPARE; reimported edits may be stale.

name: COMPARE
description: Read-only drawing comparison. Omit arguments for a .lcad picker or use FROM "absolute/file.lcad" in native Tauri. REPORT shows the cached comparison; CLOSE clears it. Reports stable-identity changes, resources, layouts and painter order in Measurements and editor.comparison. No drawing/history mutation. Model space only, close BEDIT. Changes while loading invalidate the request. Use COMPAREIMPORT for accepted changes. Before/after model previews share scale in Measurements. CLOUDS [padding arcLength] inserts editable revision clouds around affected old/new bounds, in one undo step; defaults 0.25/0.5 metres. Refuses a changed baseline, unavailable layer, unsupported bounds or more than 256 affected roots.

name: DATAEXTRACTION
description: TABLE output accepts LINKED: COUNTTABLE x y LINKED [ALL|SELECTED] [NESTED] [GROUP fields] [SUM fields] creates a query-backed table refreshed automatically with model edits in the same undo step. Tables are excluded from source counts. A selected scope retains its original IDs; deleted sources drop out. Failure status retains the previous snapshot. Extract model object quantities and block attributes. [LIST|CSV|JSON|XLS|TABLE x y] [ALL|SELECTED] [NESTED] [GROUP type,layer,block|NONE] [SUM length,area|NONE] [TO "absolute/path.csv/json"]. Field names are case-sensitive; attribute columns use attribute:TAG. Default LIST ALL groups by type,layer,block and sums length/area. Measurements use metres/m²; measured-count columns distinguish unknown quantities. NESTED includes evaluated block children. LIST previews at most 30 groups; editor.dataExtraction contains the complete snapshot. TABLE creates an editable native table in one undo step. Exports never change the drawing. Model space only; close BEDIT. SAVE name [ALL|SELECTED] [NESTED] [GROUP fields|NONE] [SUM fields|NONE] saves an undoable query; RUN name [LIST|CSV|JSON|XLS|TABLE x y] [TO path] recomputes it, DEFINITIONS lists names, DELETE name removes it. Saved SELECTED queries retain root IDs and refuse missing sources.

name: COUNTLIST
description: List current model counts using the extraction engine. [ALL|SELECTED] [NESTED] [GROUP type,layer,block|NONE]. Defaults to all root objects; supports the DATAEXTRACTION CSV/JSON output options. No history mutation.

name: COUNTTABLE
description: TABLE output accepts LINKED: COUNTTABLE x y LINKED [ALL|SELECTED] [NESTED] [GROUP fields] [SUM fields] creates a query-backed table refreshed automatically with model edits in the same undo step. Tables are excluded from source counts. A selected scope retains its original IDs; deleted sources drop out. Failure status retains the previous snapshot. Insert an editable count table at x y in model metres. x y [ALL|SELECTED] [NESTED] [GROUP type,layer,block|NONE]. Recomputes current quantities; one undo step. Uses the shared native table model.

name: ADCENTER
description: Open the reusable content browser in the Blocks palette. No arguments shows the current source or asks for a .lcad file. OPEN ["absolute/path.lcad"] selects a source; browser mode uses the file picker. Lists exported library roots, or named definitions and the whole model of an ordinary drawing, with a read-only preview. SELECT n changes the preview; IMPORT n imports only that entry and its transitive dependencies; INSERT n imports then starts normal interactive insertion. Numbers are one-based in editor.contentBrowser.entries. CLOSE discards the browser snapshot. Source inspection does not change the drawing; imports use existing conflict resolution and one undo step. Cached source content remains until another OPEN. Close BEDIT/REFEDIT first.

name: SAVETEMPLATE
description: Save the complete current drawing as a reusable .lcad template without changing its current path or session. With no arguments uses Save As/download; TO "absolute/path.lcad" exports directly in native Tauri. Includes content, styles, settings, assets, layouts and page setups. Native export refuses to overwrite the active drawing or the template used to create it. Use NEW TEMPLATE, NEW FROM or QNEW to instantiate. DWT is a command alias only; the file is LUMCAD .lcad, not Autodesk DWT. Close BEDIT/REFEDIT first.

name: QNEW
description: Create a drawing using the default .lcad template path configured in Settings, or a blank drawing if no template is configured. No arguments. Native templates are reread each time; missing or invalid files report an error without replacing the current drawing. Browser requests the template file again when a default path is configured. Uses the same save prompt, fresh identity and source protection as NEW FROM. Close BEDIT/REFEDIT first.

name: RECOVERALL
description: Native batch recovery: [FROM "absolute/root.lcad"], or select a root file. Inspects root plus external drawing references in model, blocks and layouts, including overlays, unloaded snapshots and discarded insertions. Relative paths resolve beside their source; canonical paths deduplicate symlinks. Reads up to 32 files, 8 dependency levels and 300 MiB of input bytes plus 314572800 serialized candidate characters, with 2048 reference edges. Reports cycles, missing sources, unresolved defects and limits per file without writing originals or reloading host geometry. Opens the Recovery Manager report. REPORT shows the batch again. Use RECOVERYMANAGER SELECT n or OPEN n to review or open a ready unsaved copy. Browser filesystem traversal is unavailable. Close BEDIT/REFEDIT first.

name: RECOVERYMANAGER
description: Show the latest RECOVERALL batch report. SELECT n displays one candidate with its complete repair/loss report; OPEN n opens a ready candidate as an unsaved copy after the normal save prompt. File numbers are one-based (1-32). Missing/invalid candidates cannot open. The batch remains available when switching between recovered copies within the session. HISTORY lists up to twelve persistent metadata summaries. RETRY n re-reads the selected historical source (or prompts for a browser file); REMOVE n removes only its summary. History numbers are one-based (1-12). Historical summaries never authorize opening stale candidates. RELINK updates reference paths in the active recovered copy using saved batch locations, in one undo step; it preserves cached geometry and refuses unrelated drawings or block-edit sessions.

name: RECOVER
description: Inspect and prepare recovery from a damaged .lcad: omit arguments for a file picker, or FROM "absolute/file.lcad" in native Tauri. REPORT shows the last candidate. OPEN explicitly opens a ready candidate as an unsaved recovered copy after the normal current-document save flow. The initial read does not change the active drawing or write source bytes. The current native file cannot be used as a recovery source; close it first. Reports archive defects, repairs, unresolved issues and quarantined raw objects in Measurements and editor.inquiryResult. Unsupported manifests or unresolved graphs cannot open. The recovered session preserves its report and protects the source path during Save As. Close BEDIT/REFEDIT first.

name: AUDIT
description: Integrity report for the current document: CHECK (default) or REPAIR. REPAIR currently restores missing layers with stable IDs and reassigns invalid layer ownership to layer 0, preserving geometry; reports changes and unresolved defects, with one undo entry. Examines raw model, block-local and paper-space entities before normalization. Reports identifiers, geometry, missing dependencies/resources and constraint-catalog defects with exact paths. Opens the shared Measurements report; structured issues are also in editor.inquiryResult. Bounded traversal rejects partial success. Close BEDIT/REFEDIT first; CHECK never mutates, REPAIR never saves automatically.

name: FLATTEN
description: Project selected native geometry onto world XY, or ALL; PREVIEW reports without mutation. LUMCAD geometry is already 2D: removes residual nonzero z/z1/z2/cz/elevation/thickness values while retaining XY, identity, appearance and 2D constraints. Traverses compound curves and native source points; planar objects are unchanged. Locked and shared block/reference objects are protected; edit block contents explicitly in BEDIT. Non-world OCS orientations reject atomically. One undo entry; report distinguishes flattened, already planar and protected objects.

name: PURGE
description: Remove unused definitions across model and paper space: [ALL|BLOCKS|LAYERS|STYLES] [PREVIEW]. Default ALL; PREVIEW reports without mutation. Traces nested block and resource dependencies, preserves defaults/current styles/current layer, saved layer states and dependencies of catalogs outside scope. Removes unused blocks, layers, text/dimension/multiline/table/leader styles; retains assets for undo and plot-style mappings. Bounded atomic traversal, one undo entry. Close BEDIT/REFEDIT first.

name: OVERKILL
description: Clean selected model objects, or ALL. PREVIEW reports without mutation. TOLERANCE metres (0..1, default 1e-9), MERGE ON|OFF (default ON). Removes exact duplicate objects, reversed/tolerance-equivalent native curves and point polylines, closed paths with shifted starting vertices, zero-length lines/point paths, and unions connected collinear continuous lines with identical properties. Preserves first identity and painter order. Locked, generated and referenced identities are protected, including constraints/groups/fields. Appearance and metadata compare exactly. Bounded 250000 comparisons; overflow refuses atomically. One undo entry; report gives duplicate, zero-length, merge and protected counts.

name: PEDIT
description: Edit one selected editable point or connected native-curve polyline. With no arguments opens the shared vertex panel. VERTEX index x y moves a vertex; INSERT index x y inserts before the one-based index (count+1 appends); REMOVE index deletes a vertex; CLOSE, OPEN and REVERSE change topology/direction. Coordinates are world metres. Minimum two open or three closed vertices; maximum 8192. Degenerate or constrained incompatible edits reject atomically. Native curve paths support REVERSE, CLOSE (adds a closing line if needed), OPEN (opens a seam without deleting geometry), and SPLIT one-based-segment parameter (strictly between 0 and 1), preserving line/arc/ellipse/cubic geometry and appearance, up to 4096 parts. Point-only VERTEX/INSERT/REMOVE reject curve paths. Generated linework uses MLEDIT; spline control edits use SPLINEDIT. One undo per edit.

name: DCCONVERT
description: Convert selected associative linear, radial or angular annotations into named driving constraints while retaining their presentation. Optional name prefix (default d) produces unique names. Initial targets use the exact underlying measurement, including rotated projections and reflex/angular arc modes. Later DIMCONSTRAINT SET edits drive source geometry. Repeated conversion skips existing links. Detached, unsupported or locked annotations reject the whole batch. Model space or ordinary BEDIT; close REFEDIT first.

name: PARAMETERS
description: List and edit named model or block-local parameters: LIST; SET name number|distance|angle "expression"; DELETE name. Formulas may reference other parameters and named driving dimensions. Changes solve dependent geometry in one undo entry. Cycles, unknown references and conflicts reject atomically. Available in model space or ordinary BEDIT; close REFEDIT first.

name: DIMCONSTRAINT
description: Create a driving dimension: linear|aligned|angular|radius|diameter name "expression" [X|Y for linear] [references]. LIST reports evaluated parameters and dimensions. SET name|id "expression" updates a driver. DELETE name|id|SELECTED|ALL removes dimensions unless a formula depends on them. References use the geometric-constraint syntax. Model space or ordinary BEDIT; close REFEDIT first.

name: DCLINEAR
description: Create a linear driving dimension: name "expression" X|Y [references]. Omitted references use selected objects. A reference is a one-based selection index or entityId, optionally @grip or @part:grip (zero-based part). Linear/aligned accepts one line or two points; angular accepts two directed lines (0–360 degrees, endpoints excluded); radius/diameter accepts a circle or arc. Named expressions share PARAMETERS. Conflicts reject atomically; one undo entry. Model space or ordinary BEDIT; close REFEDIT first.

name: DCALIGNED
description: Create an aligned driving dimension: name "expression" [references]. Omitted references use selected objects. A reference is a one-based selection index or entityId, optionally @grip or @part:grip (zero-based part). Linear/aligned accepts one line or two points; angular accepts two directed lines (0–360 degrees, endpoints excluded); radius/diameter accepts a circle or arc. Named expressions share PARAMETERS. Conflicts reject atomically; one undo entry. Model space or ordinary BEDIT; close REFEDIT first.

name: DCANGULAR
description: Create an angular driving dimension: name "expression" [references]. Omitted references use selected objects. A reference is a one-based selection index or entityId, optionally @grip or @part:grip (zero-based part). Linear/aligned accepts one line or two points; angular accepts two directed lines (0–360 degrees, endpoints excluded); radius/diameter accepts a circle or arc. Named expressions share PARAMETERS. Conflicts reject atomically; one undo entry. Model space or ordinary BEDIT; close REFEDIT first.

name: DCRADIUS
description: Create a radius driving dimension: name "expression" [references]. Omitted references use selected objects. A reference is a one-based selection index or entityId, optionally @grip or @part:grip (zero-based part). Linear/aligned accepts one line or two points; angular accepts two directed lines (0–360 degrees, endpoints excluded); radius/diameter accepts a circle or arc. Named expressions share PARAMETERS. Conflicts reject atomically; one undo entry. Model space or ordinary BEDIT; close REFEDIT first.

name: DCDIAMETER
description: Create a diameter driving dimension: name "expression" [references]. Omitted references use selected objects. A reference is a one-based selection index or entityId, optionally @grip or @part:grip (zero-based part). Linear/aligned accepts one line or two points; angular accepts two directed lines (0–360 degrees, endpoints excluded); radius/diameter accepts a circle or arc. Named expressions share PARAMETERS. Conflicts reject atomically; one undo entry. Model space or ordinary BEDIT; close REFEDIT first.

name: AUTOCONSTRAIN
description: Detect and solve geometric relations on selected native model objects in one undo entry. Optional PREVIEW reports proposals without changes. Options: TOLERANCE metres (default 0.0001, maximum 1), ANGLE degrees (default 0.1, maximum 10), TYPES comma-separated subset of coincident,horizontal,vertical,collinear,concentric,parallel,perpendicular,tangent,smooth,equal. Positive tolerances only. Existing relations are retained and duplicate proposals skipped. Conflicts and limits reject atomically. At most 64 selected objects and 128 curve parts. Model space and BEDIT.

name: GEOMCONSTRAINT
description: Create: type [references]. Types: coincident, collinear, concentric, equal, fix, horizontal, parallel, perpendicular, symmetric, tangent, vertical, smooth. LIST reports relations. DELETE id|SELECTED|ALL removes relations without moving geometry. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point. Segment references: 1@0:start or 1@0: (zero-based part). Whole-object refs omit @. Solves and adds persistent relations in one undo entry; conflicts reject atomically. Model space and BEDIT.

name: GCCOINCIDENT
description: Coincident constraint. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point. Segment references: 1@0:start or 1@0: (zero-based part). Whole-object refs omit @. Solves and adds persistent relations in one undo entry; conflicts reject atomically. Model space and BEDIT.

name: GCCOLLINEAR
description: Collinear constraint. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point. Segment references: 1@0:start or 1@0: (zero-based part). Whole-object refs omit @. Solves and adds persistent relations in one undo entry; conflicts reject atomically. Model space and BEDIT.

name: GCCONCENTRIC

name: GCEQUAL
description: Equal constraint. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point. FIX snapshots each selected object or point.

description: Horizontal constraint. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point. description: Symmetric constraint. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point. description: Tangent constraint. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point.
