TANGENT optionally ends with INTERNAL or EXTERNAL for circular tangency.

name: GCVERTICAL
description: Vertical constraint. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point. Segment references: 1@0:start or 1@0: (zero-based part). Whole-object refs omit @. Solves and adds persistent relations in one undo entry; conflicts reject atomically. Model space and BEDIT.

name: GCSMOOTH
description: Smooth constraint. Select native model objects, then optionally specify references as 1@start 2@end (one-based selection), or entityId@point. Segment references: 1@0:start or 1@0: (zero-based part). Whole-object refs omit @. Solves and adds persistent relations in one undo entry; conflicts reject atomically. Model space and BEDIT. Endpoint references required; enforces joint position, tangent and intrinsic G2 curvature.

name: BLOCKDETECT
description: Read-only detection of disjoint occurrences of the selected native motif in model space. Same appearance and metadata required. Translation supported for all eligible types; rotation and uniform scaling use line, arc or point-polyline anchors (including rectangles/polygons); circle anchors support scaling. Reports count including selected motif. No arguments. Limits: 128 source objects, 10000 drawing objects, bounded comparison budget.

name: BCONVERT
description: Convert the selected motif and matching occurrences to instances of one new named block: BCONVERT "new name". Recomputes detection; at least two matches required. Preserves geometry, appearance, groups and painter order; rejects external dependencies, partial groups or interleaved occurrences. Atomic, one undo. Model space only, outside BEDIT.

name: BLOCKREPLACE
description: Replace selected editable native block instances with an existing definition: BLOCKREPLACE "name". Preserves reference IDs and transforms, synchronizes matching attributes and valid dynamic parameters. Entire selection validated before one undoable commit. Model space only, outside BEDIT.

name: BLOOKUPTABLE
description: In BEDIT: SET tableName choiceParameter choice outputParameter value [outputParameter value ...]. Builds/updates one variant row; other rows initialize new outputs to parameter defaults. Point values take x y, flip ON/OFF, strings quoted. DELETE tableName; LIST. Cycles and duplicate writers rejected.

name: BTABLE
description: BEDIT table authoring uses the BLOOKUPTABLE syntax. In model space select one dynamic instance then APPLY tableName choice to apply a variant row. Lookup outputs cannot be edited directly; change the selector.

name: BVSTATE
description: In BEDIT: SET choiceParameter state uses selected local objects as the visible membership for that state; empty selection creates an empty state. Other states initially show all objects. DELETE removes visibility; LIST reports the draft. Instance choice parameters switch states.

name: BPARAMETER
description: In BEDIT: SET name distance|angle|number default [MIN n MAX n STEP n]; SET name point x y; SET name flip ON|OFF; SET name choice default choice1 choice2...; DELETE name; LIST. Outside BEDIT: SET name value (or x y / ON OFF) on one selected dynamic instance. Atomic undo.

name: BACTION
description: In BEDIT, select source objects then SET id MOVE parameter dx dy; STRETCH parameter dx dy minX minY maxX maxY; ROTATE or SCALE parameter originX originY; FLIP parameter originX originY axisEndX axisEndY; ARRAY parameter offsetX offsetY. Point-parameter MOVE/STRETCH omit direction dx dy. DELETE id; LIST. Parameters must exist. Save with BSAVE or BCLOSE SAVE.

name: RESETBLOCK
description: Reset selected editable dynamic block instances to definition defaults, preserving IDs, placement and attributes. One undo; reject the batch if any target is invalid or locked.

name: TOLERANCE
description: Create an editable geometric-tolerance frame: symbol value [DIAMETER] [MATERIAL M|L|S] [SECOND value ...] [DATUM A[:M|L|S]] (up to 3 datums), then optional further symbol/value rows (max 4). Symbols: straightness, flatness, circularity, cylindricity, lineProfile, surfaceProfile, angularity, perpendicularity, parallelism, position, concentricity, symmetry, runout, totalRunout. Global PROJECTED positive-height, IDENTIFIER datum-label, STYLE "name". Pick/type insertion point; Escape cancels. EDIT replaces one selected frame definition retaining placement; STYLE LIST/SET/DELETE uses the shared table style catalogue; STYLE APPLY "name" applies a snapshot. Values are displayed as entered, without unit conversion; drawing frame sizes use metres. One undo.

name: FIELD
description: Set a field on one selected model/paper text, or start model text placement with no selection. Sources: META key; DOCUMENT name|createdAt|updatedAt; OBJECT id length|perimeter|area|radius|diameter|width|height|x|y|type|layer|text; CELL table-id A1; REF field-id; DATE iso|datetime|year|dmy|mdy (UTC); PAGE number|count|name [LAYOUT id]; FORMULA "expression" [BIND variable "source specification"]. Options PREFIX "text", SUFFIX "text", PRECISION 0..8. SHOW displays definition; REMOVE detaches selected text while keeping cached value. One undo. Missing sources/cycles display explicit errors.

name: UPDATEFIELD
description: ALL (default) refreshes field text in model and paper layouts; SELECTED refreshes selected field text in the current workspace. Uses one document/time snapshot and commits once, preserving source definitions. Locked targets reject the batch. PAGE fields on paper resolve their own layout; field formulas can bind metadata, geometry and linked table cells. Read-only source evaluation; never reads source CSV files (use DATALINKUPDATE first).

name: DATALINK
description: CSV table sources: LIST; ATTACH [FROM "absolute/path.csv"] [DELIMITER COMMA|SEMICOLON|TAB] to one selected editable table; DETACH selected tables. ATTACH reads cells now, retains formatting/position, stores source metadata. File picker when FROM omitted. Browser links prompt for file again on refresh. No automatic filesystem reads when opening documents; no source writes. One undo.

name: DATALINKUPDATE
description: Reload selected linked tables, or ALL model-space linked tables, from their CSV sources. All targets must be editable. One atomic history entry after all reads succeed; failure, cancellation or concurrent document change leaves all tables unchanged. Retains formatting and placement; grows dimensions with style defaults and drops merges outside new bounds. Existing values are replaced from source.

name: TABLEEXPORT
description: Export one selected table as UTF-8 CSV: [VALUES|FORMULAS] [DELIMITER COMMA|SEMICOLON|TAB] [TO "absolute/path.csv"]. Default evaluated values and comma. Desktop save dialog or browser download; explicit paths require desktop. Read-only, including locked tables. Merged cells retain their underlying values.

name: TABLESTYLE
description: LIST; SET "name" [FONT metres] [PADDING metres] [ROWHEIGHT metres] [COLWIDTH metres] [LINEWEIGHT weight] [HEADERS count] [COLOR #rrggbb] [GRIDCOLOR #rrggbb] [ALIGN left|center|right] [BOLD ON|OFF]; APPLY "name" to one selected table; DELETE "name" (except Standard). Max 128 styles. Existing tables retain style snapshots until explicitly applied. One undo.

name: TABLE
description: TABLE rows columns [rowHeight columnWidth], defaults 3 3, 0.6 and 2 metres. Pick/type insertion point. Native editable table with cells/formulas, styles and merges, max 256 rows, 64 columns, 4096 cells. Escape cancels; one undo. Alternatively CSV [DELIMITER COMMA|SEMICOLON|TAB] [FROM "path.csv"] imports a UTF-8 CSV (4 MiB, 4096 cells maximum) before picking insertion point. Native path or file picker; source is a snapshot. Cancel before placement leaves the document unchanged.

name: TABLEDIT
description: DETACHQUANTITIES removes a quantity table query while retaining cached cells; linked cells cannot be edited or merged until detached. With no arguments, open the shared property editor for one selected editable table. Otherwise: FORMAT A1 RESET or FORMAT A1 [FONT metres] [PADDING metres] [COLOR #rrggbb] [ALIGN left|center|right] [BOLD ON|OFF]; CELL A1 "text or =formula"; MERGE A1 B2; UNMERGE A1; ROWHEIGHT one-based-row metres; COLWIDTH one-based-column metres. References A1, arithmetic and SUM/AVERAGE/MIN/MAX/COUNT ranges are evaluated; cycles and invalid references remain explicit errors. Hidden merged values are preserved. Atomic one-step undo.

name: REVCLOUD
description: REVCLOUD [RECT|POLYGON|OBJECT] [arcLength] [REVERSE]. Default RECT 0.5 m. RECT takes two corners; POLYGON takes vertices then END/CLOSE; OBJECT converts one selected or picked editable closed path, retaining its ID. UNDO removes the last construction vertex; Escape cancels. Native arc cloud, max 2048 arcs, one undo.

name: REVCLOUDPROPERTIES
description: REVCLOUDPROPERTIES arcLength [NORMAL|REVERSE] rebuilds selected editable revision clouds. Length in metres; max 2048 arcs. Atomic update and one undo.

name: BREAKLINE
description: BREAKLINE [size [extension]] takes two endpoint point actions. Default zigzag size 0.5 m, endpoint extension half size; positive size must fit within the line. Native editable polyline with retained parameters; one undo, Escape cancels.

name: SKETCH
description: SKETCH [incrementMetres] [POLYLINE|LINES], default 0.01 POLYLINE. Drag to record a freehand stroke with distance-based sampling; release commits one undo step. Raw pointer ignores snaps. Point actions/text coordinates accumulate samples; RECORD/END commits them. Enter with no stroke ends; Escape discards the active stroke. Limit 8192 points, increment 0.000001..1000000 m.

name: PLINE
description: PLINE [startWidth endWidth] creates a connected polyline (metres). Pick/type vertices; WIDTH start end changes the next segment, UNDO removes its last vertex, END/Enter commits, CLOSE closes, Escape cancels. Zero widths make thin lines. Widths 0..1000000, max 512 vertices. One undo. ARC signed-angle-degrees (magnitude 0.001..359) sets the next circular sweep; LINE restores straight segments. Curved ribbon boundaries are materialized within 0.0001 m, with bounded subdivision and rejection of inner-radius collapse; the editable arc definition is retained.

name: MLINE
description: MLINE [STYLE "name"] [SCALE factor] [JUSTIFY zero|top|bottom]. Pick or type 2–512 vertices. END/Enter commits, CLOSE closes with at least 3 vertices, UNDO removes the last vertex, Escape cancels. Live offset/cap/fill preview; one undo.

name: MLSTYLE
description: LIST; DELETE "name"; SET "name" ELEMENT offset [COLOR #rrggbb] [LINETYPE continuous|dashed|dotted] ELEMENT offset ... [START none|line|arc] [END none|line|arc] [FILL ON|OFF]. 2–16 unique offsets, max 128 named styles. Editing/deleting a style retains existing object snapshots; Standard cannot be deleted. One undo.

name: DONUT
description: DONUT innerDiameter outerDiameter, in metres (0 <= inner < outer <= 1000000). Omitted diameters are requested together. Pick centers repeatedly; each ring/disc is one undo step. Escape ends placement. Retains editable exact curved geometry.

name: MLEDIT
description: With no arguments, open the shared property editor for one selected editable linework object. Otherwise edit selected editable linework atomically: DIAMETERS inner outer (donuts), SCALE factor or JUSTIFY zero|top|bottom (multilines), WIDTH start end [one-based segment] (wide paths), CLOSE, OPEN, VERTEX one-based-index localX localY. Invalid mixed selections are refused. One undo step.

name: PDFSHXTEXT
description: [quoted SHX/SHP font path] HEIGHT cap-height-metres [ANGLE world-degrees] [THRESHOLD 80-100]. Select imported editable model strokes first. Opens a font picker when path omitted. Matches complete stroke glyphs against the supplied classic/Unicode font, preserving ambiguous/unmatched/locked objects. Known height and baseline direction are required (ANGLE defaults to 0); threshold defaults to 95. Converts adjacent compatible glyphs into native editable text with a substitute technical font and fitted width. One undo. Local bounded decoding; font bytes are not embedded. BIGFONT, vertical, reflected/sheared text and non-Unicode multibyte fonts are unsupported.

name: PDFIMPORT
description: [ALL|GEOMETRY|TEXT|FILLS|IMAGES] [quoted PDF path] [PAGE n] [SCALE factor] [AT worldX worldY], or [ALL|GEOMETRY|TEXT|FILLS|IMAGES] UNDERLAY for the selected PDF. ALL (the default) imports all supported categories atomically in original PDF draw order, with fills before their strokes. Imports visible stroked lines and exact cubic splines as editable independent model objects on the active editable layer. Respects PDF page/graphics clips, optional-content visibility, and selected underlay transform/crop. Retains the source underlay. GEOMETRY excludes fills, text and images. TEXT imports visible horizontal-font text with native affine frames, substitute fonts and fitted run widths; polygon/curve/compound clipping uses native blocks when needed. FILLS imports solid fills as native hatches with exact curve boundaries and even-odd/nonzero winding, without adding an outline stroke. Glyph clips use available decoded font outlines as native cubic contours, accumulated until the text object ends. Type3/vertical text fonts and missing glyph outlines are refused. IMAGES imports decoded image objects as shared embedded PNG assets with native affine frames and polygon/curve/compound clips. Solid-colour stencil image masks preserve their transparent pixels and current fill colour. Pattern-painted masks and unsupported advanced graphics effects are omitted with a warning. Text/fill/image clips retain native line/cubic contours and winding holes in editable blocks. One undo.

name: PDFATTACH
description: Attach a local PDF page as a portable native underlay. Input optional quoted path, PAGE n, SCALE positiveFactor and AT worldX worldY (metres); omitted path opens the file picker, default page 1 and physical paper scale. Stores original PDF and rendered preview locally with native vector snaps. One undo step.

name: PDFCLIP
description: Clip one selected editable PDF underlay. RECT x1 y1 x2 y2, POLYGON x1 y1 ... , ON, OFF, DELETE. Coordinates are page-local metres before the insertion transform. Shared block clipping applies to rendering and snaps; one undo.

name: PDFLAYERS
description: For a selected PDF underlay, LIST reports optional-content group IDs/names/visibility. ON or OFF followed by a quoted layer name/ID or * changes PDF layer visibility, rerenders the embedded source and refreshes snaps atomically. Preserves insertion, clipping and original source bytes; one undo.

name: CHSPACE
description: Move selected model objects to the active layout, or the selected paper annotation back to model. Input optional quoted viewport name/ID then layout name/ID; otherwise use selected/sole viewport. Preserves displayed placement through viewport scale/rotation, metres/mm conversion, and native curves/dependencies. Paper transfer uses an editable native block container; returning it restores native objects. Annotation appearances are frozen at viewport scale. Locked entity layers and dangling dependencies refuse transfer. Does not change the viewport; one document undo step.

name: EXPORTLAYOUT
description: Export the active layout, or input a quoted layout name/ID, to a separate native .lcad model. Opens the destination dialog. Viewport rotations/scales/clips, per-viewport layer and annotation snapshots and paper annotations become editable native blocks in paper metres. Does not edit the source drawing or its recovery file; refuses overwriting the active drawing.

name: ALIGNSPACE
description: Align one selected unlocked layout viewport using two model points and two corresponding paper points. Input modelX1 modelY1 modelX2 modelY2 paperX1 paperY1 paperX2 paperY2 (metres then mm). Empty input starts four snapped paper-space picks: two model features as displayed in the viewport, then two target paper points. Solves uniform scale, rotation and translation; preserves viewport frame/clip/layers. Escape cancels, one undo.

name: XCOMPARE
description: Compare a cached reference with its current .lcad source: [referenceID [quoted path]]. Omitted ID uses selection; missing path opens picker. Reports added/removed/changed source entity IDs and resource changes in the shared result panel and editor.inquiryResult. No drawing edits.

name: REFEDIT
description: Edit the selected external .lcad source, or input a reference ID. Native linked path required. Reads current source into a separate undoable draft, preserving its IDs/layouts/resources. Host context is shown faded in source coordinates. REFSAVE writes explicitly with revision checking; REFCLOSE DISCARD leaves source unchanged.

name: REFSAVE
description: Save the active reference draft to its linked source using a checked atomic write, and reload its host cache. Source writes cannot be undone from the host drawing. Keeps reference editor open.

name: REFCLOSE
description: SAVE (default) or DISCARD closes the active reference edit session. SAVE checks source revision before replacing it; stale source edits are refused and the draft remains open.

name: XREF
description: LIST; ATTACH/OVERLAY [quoted .lcad path [worldX worldY]]; SELECT/RELOAD/UNLOAD/DETACH/BIND [reference ID]; PATH referenceID [quoted .lcad path]; MODE referenceID ATTACH|OVERLAY. Omitted ID uses single selection. Omitted path opens file picker. Native source path/revision with portable cached blocks; source I/O only on explicit attach/reload. Undoable host edits.

name: XATTACH
description: Attach a native .lcad drawing: [ATTACH|OVERLAY] [quoted path [worldX worldY]]. Omitted path opens picker. Default insertion 0,0 metres. Linked native references cache their geometry for portable archives.

name: XBIND
description: Bind selected external drawing reference, or input its ID, to ordinary native block geometry. Keeps insertion and clipping; no source file write. Undoable.

name: XCLIP
description: Clip one selected block/reference using definition-local metres: RECT x1 y1 x2 y2; POLYGON x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3 ...; ON/OFF/DELETE. Up to128 simple polygon vertices. Rendering, bounds, snapping and SVG share the clip; EXPLODE requires disabled clipping. Undoable.

name: OBJECTSCALE
description: Annotative text/dimensions/hatches/block references: ON/OFF, ADD/DELETE denominator, OFFSET denominator x y, LIST. Select editable objects. Base geometry is shared; each scale has an optional model-metre offset. OFF keeps current size. One undo step.

name: SCALELISTEDIT
description: Annotation-scale catalog: LIST, ADD/DELETE denominator, RESET, CURRENT denominator, ALLVISIBLE ON/OFF. Current model annotation denominator is independent of zoom. Viewports use their actual scale and ignore show-all. Used scales cannot be deleted.

name: ANNOUPDATE
description: Rebase selected annotative objects to the current scale without changing appearance. Shared geometry edits already synchronize all scale representations. Undoable.

name: ANNORESET
description: Reset all per-scale representation offsets for selected annotative objects; retain scale lists and geometry. Undoable.

name: UNITS
description: Report or update pairs DISPLAY mm|cm|m|km|in|ft|yd, PRECISION 0..8, ANGLE degrees|radians|gradians, ANGLEPRECISION 0..8, CLOCKWISE ON|OFF, BASE degrees, ALTERNATE unit|OFF, INSERTION unit. Internal coordinates and bare lengths remain metres; suffixes convert explicit units. Display affects inquiry results; native .lcad insertion retains known metre scale.

name: UCS
description: WORLD; SET worldOriginX worldOriginY rotationDegrees; SAVE "name", RESTORE "name", DELETE "name", LIST. Typed point coordinates and relative offsets use current UCS; MCP point actions remain world coordinates. Grid and ortho/polar tracking rotate with UCS; model geometry remains unchanged. Max128 named frames.

name: UCSICON
description: ON or OFF toggles the model-space UCS indicator. Positive drawing Y follows stored screen-down coordinates; the upward indicator is labelled −Y.

name: LIMITS
description: Input world-coordinate minX minY maxX maxY in metres to enable a drawing limit rectangle, or ON/OFF to toggle existing bounds. New pointer/typed point input outside bounds is refused; selection and existing geometry remain unchanged. Bounded finite coordinates, positive extents, undo/archive support.

name: STYLESMANAGER
description: Open the reusable plot-style panel; optional PLOTSTYLE grammar also accepted.

name: PLOTSTYLE
description: LIST; SAVE "name" sourceColor|- outputColor|- weight|- screeningPercent lineType|-; APPLY "name" or - to selected objects; LAYER "layer" "style"; DELETE "name". Weights 1,1.5,2,3,5,10; line types continuous/dashed/dotted. Named/color-dependent mappings affect publication only. Max256 styles.

name: CONVERTPSTYLES
description: Input NAMED, COLOR or OFF. Switch publication mapping mode; NAMED assigns matching source-color rules to current objects and layers. One undo step. Does not change model appearance.

name: CONVERTCTB
description: Convert the drawing-native color-dependent mapping catalog to named plot assignments. No proprietary binary CTB/STB import; presets are stored in portable .lcad data.

name: LAYERSTATE
description: LIST, SAVE "name", RESTORE "name", DELETE "name". Store/restore layer visibility, freeze, lock, appearance, plot flags and current layer. Unknown/deleted layers are ignored and new layers retained; catalog max 128 states of 2048 layers.

name: LAYERSTATESAVE
description: Save current layer state under a quoted name.

name: LAYISO
description: Isolate layers named in input, or layers of selected model entities. Capture initial state once; LAYUNISO restores it. Undoable; no entity deletion.

name: LAYUNISO
description: Restore the layer state captured before LAYISO or LAYWALK.

name: LAYWALK
description: Show only named layers, retaining original state across subsequent walks; END restores it. Empty input uses selection layers.

name: LAYMRG
description: Input one or more source layer names followed by target. Atomic merge remaps root/nested entities, active layer and layout references while preserving entity IDs. Protected system sources and locked source/target layers are rejected.

name: LAYTRANS
description: Input pairs of source and target layer names. Atomic mapping/merge into existing layers, with the same safeguards as LAYMRG. Use quotes for spaces.

name: LAYERFILTER
description: Filter the shared layer panel by case-insensitive name words and flags locked, frozen, visible, hidden, noplot. Empty input clears the session filter.

name: LAYER
description: Input "layer" FREEZE|NEWVPFREEZE|PLOT|LOCK|VISIBLE ON|OFF. Freeze excludes rendering/picking/snapping; new-VP-freeze initializes new viewport hidden layers; no-plot affects publication only. Layer panel exposes freeze/new-VP-freeze/plot controls.

name: MLEADER
description: Create a leader: optional quoted text (\n for newlines), or BLOCK "name". Pick/type at least two points from arrow tip through bends, DONE, then pick/type content anchor. UNDO removes last point. Escape cancels. Native block-backed geometry; one undo step.

name: MLEADEREDIT
description: Select one leader. TEXT "content", BLOCK "name", ADD (pick two branch points), REMOVE oneBasedBranchIndex. Content and vertex grips edit leaders independently of their copies. BEDIT is refused for generated definitions; EXPLODE detaches geometry.

name: MLEADERALIGN
description: Select at least two leaders. X or Y aligns content origins to first selected leader; optional nonnegative spacing distributes on other axis. Arrow tips remain fixed. One atomic undo step.

name: MLEADERCOLLECT
description: Collect 2..32 selected leaders into one leader with all branches and a reusable block of annotation contents in a horizontal row. Optional gap in metres, default 0.5. Retains first identity and appearance; one undo step.

name: MLEADERSTYLE
description: LIST; SAVE "name" textSize arrowSize landingLength closed|open|none; USE "name" for future leaders; APPLY "name" to selection; DELETE "name". Sizes in metres. Named presets persist; instances snapshot styles, no live association. Limit 128 presets.

name: QSELECT
description: Replace selection by AND predicates: TYPE line LAYER "name" COLOR #rrggbb LINETYPE dashed WEIGHT >= 0.25 TRANSPARENCY < 50 BLOCK "name" LOCKED YES/NO. Equality is default, != supported; ordered comparisons only for numeric fields. Uses resolved ByLayer appearance and excludes hidden objects.

name: FILTER
description: Persistent filters: SAVE "name" predicates (same grammar as QSELECT), APPLY "name", DELETE "name", LIST. Up to 128 filters of 16 predicates; save/delete use history and archive persistence.

name: SELECTSIMILAR
description: Select visible objects matching any selected source on TYPE LAYER BLOCK by default. Optional field names choose matching properties, using the QSELECT fields and resolved appearance.

name: SELECTCOUNT
description: Count the current selection by type, layer and block name; display result rows in the Measurements panel and editor.inquiryResult.

name: COUNT
description: Count selected objects, or all visible objects when selection is empty; ALL forces all. Select/highlight counted objects. After COUNT, SELECTCOUNT, COUNTAREA or BCOUNT, COUNT NEXT|PREVIOUS|ITEM n navigates the last count (one-based n), selects the model owner and centers occurrence bounds; changed drawings require recounting. COUNT DUPLICATES [ALL] [NESTED] [TOLERANCE metres] diagnoses coincident curves and same-definition block instances; NESTED compares transformed block occurrences with distinct paths, selects their model roots and centers the matching bounds. Clipped/external interiors are explicitly unverified. It highlights suspect groups without deletion and reports unsupported objects; tolerance 0..1, default 0.000001 m. COUNT DUPLICATES NEXT|PREVIOUS|GROUP n selects and centers a suspect group (one-based GROUP n); navigation refuses a changed drawing until diagnosis is rerun. COUNT TABLE x y inserts the last report as a static editable grouped native text/line schedule at model coordinates. At most 200 rows; one undo step; no live link.

name: COUNTAREA
description: Count objects wholly inside a rectangular area. Pick two snapped corners or supply x1 y1 x2 y2 in metres. Results select/highlight counted objects. Escape cancels.

name: BCOUNT
description: Count block occurrences including nested references in the selection, or all visible model roots when selection is empty. ALL forces all. Respects inherited layers, bounded to 10000 visited nodes and depth 32; cyclic or excessive graphs fail atomically. Highlights owning model references.

name: MEASUREGEOM
description: Non-persistent inquiry: DISTANCE (default; two points), ANGLE (three points with vertex second), AREA (selection or polygon points then Enter/DONE), RADIUS, LENGTH/PERIMETER (selection or object pick). ADD/SUBTRACT accumulates selected areas; RESET clears accumulator; COPY copies the latest structured result. Metres, square metres, degrees. Results available in editor.inquiryResult and shared inquiry panel.

name: DIST
description: Distance inquiry: pick two snapped points or supply x1 y1 x2 y2 in metres. Reports distance, dx/dy and angle without creating geometry.

name: AREA
description: Area/perimeter inquiry for selected closed native paths and regions with islands, or pick polygon vertices then Enter/DONE. Summed selected areas are not a Boolean union. Invalid, intersecting or excessive boundaries are rejected.

name: ID
description: Coordinate inquiry: pick one snapped point or supply x y. Reports model coordinates in metres.

name: LIST
description: List selected object geometry and properties without modification; ALL lists visible objects. Maximum 256 objects. Results can be copied from the inquiry panel.

name: STATUS
description: Report document units and model object, layer, block and selection counts.

name: MASSPROP
description: Report area, perimeter, centroid and centroidal planar X/Y moments for one closed native object or region with islands; pick a target if none selected. Unit density, square metres and metres to the fourth power. Bounded integration and intersection checks reject unsupported contours.

name: HIDEOBJECTS
description: Session-only model object visibility. HIDEOBJECTS hides the selection; ISOLATEOBJECTS hides all other objects, preserving previous hides; UNISOLATEOBJECTS restores all temporarily hidden objects without changing layer visibility. Hidden objects are excluded from rendering, picking, snaps and zoom extents. No geometry history, archive or print changes. State is exposed in editor.hiddenObjectIds.

name: ISOLATEOBJECTS
description: Session-only model object visibility. HIDEOBJECTS hides the selection; ISOLATEOBJECTS hides all other objects, preserving previous hides; UNISOLATEOBJECTS restores all temporarily hidden objects without changing layer visibility. Hidden objects are excluded from rendering, picking, snaps and zoom extents. No geometry history, archive or print changes. State is exposed in editor.hiddenObjectIds.

name: UNISOLATEOBJECTS
description: Session-only model object visibility. HIDEOBJECTS hides the selection; ISOLATEOBJECTS hides all other objects, preserving previous hides; UNISOLATEOBJECTS restores all temporarily hidden objects without changing layer visibility. Hidden objects are excluded from rendering, picking, snaps and zoom extents. No geometry history, archive or print changes. State is exposed in editor.hiddenObjectIds.

name: VIEW
description: Manage named model views: SAVE "name" (replace same name), RESTORE "name", RENAME "name" "new name", DELETE "name", LIST (default). IMPORT opens an .lcad file and imports its views with collision-safe names and new IDs. Names up to 128 characters, max 256 views. Catalog edits are undoable and persisted; restore fits the stored extent to the current canvas.

name: VIEWGO
description: Restore a named model view: VIEWGO "name". Model space only. View navigation does not create a geometry history entry.

name: MATCHPROP
description: Match source layer and ByLayer/custom color, weight, type and transparency to editable selected targets. Input optional source entity ID, otherwise pick source. Without preselection pick source then one target. Escape cancels; one undo step.

name: LAYMCH
description: Match only layer. Same source/target workflow as MATCHPROP.

name: LAYMCUR
description: Make the selected or picked source object layer current. Optional source entity ID. Locked layers rejected.

name: COPYTOLAYER
description: Copy selected editable objects in place to a named layer or layer ID supplied as input. Quote names containing spaces. New IDs and remapped dependencies; source geometry retained. Hidden or locked destination rejected. One undo step.

name: GROUP
description: Create a named non-destructive group from selection: GROUP "name". LIST lists groups and counts. Names are case-insensitively unique. One undo step.

name: GROUPEDIT
description: GROUPEDIT "name" ADD/REMOVE uses current selection; RENAME "new name"; ON/OFF toggles collective picking; SELECT selects visible members and overlapping selectable groups. Changes are undoable.

name: UNGROUP
description: Remove the named group, or all groups touching the selection when no name is supplied. Geometry is retained. One undo step.

name: CENTERLINE
description: Create an associative centre line from two selected line segments, or pick the missing sources interactively. Parallel lines produce a midline; intersecting lines produce their angle bisector. ALTERNATE chooses the other bisector. Extents cover projected source endpoints plus a default 0.25 m extension, editable in properties. Source edits update the line; source endpoint reversal preserves the bisector. Escape cancels without edits; one completed line is one undo step. MCP point picks use targetId. Supports shared rendering, clipboard, transforms, centre maintenance and archive persistence.

name: CENTERREASSOCIATE
description: Reassociate selected unlocked centre marks or centre lines with a circle/arc source ID for marks or two line source IDs for centre lines. No input starts an interactive source pick; Escape cancels. Preserves IDs and appearance. Atomic, one undo step.

name: CENTERDISASSOCIATE
description: Detach selected unlocked centre marks or centre lines, keeping exact local source snapshots. No arguments. Marks retain their position and appearance when the source is edited or deleted. Atomic, one undo step.

name: CENTERRESET
description: Reset selected unlocked centre marks or centre lines to default size, extension and primary bisector and apply the current dimension style without overrides. Retains source associations or detached snapshots and stable IDs. No arguments; atomic, one undo step.

name: DIMBREAK
description: Add manual visual gaps to selected unlocked dimensions. Input x1 y1 x2 y2 projects two world points onto the line/arc nearest the first point, on each selected dimension. REMOVE clears all gaps. Maximum 128 gaps per dimension. Intervals follow the relative position along the styled primitive as geometry changes; measurement and associations remain intact. Shared model/print/SVG rendering, atomic edit and one-step undo. No input or MANUAL starts two snapped point picks with live preview; coordinate input and MCP point actions are supported. Escape cancels without edits. AUTO [gap in metres [source IDs...]] enables dynamic intersection gaps against supported curve sources (lines, arcs, circles, ellipses, splines, polylines, rectangles, polygons, hatch/region boundaries). Without IDs uses current visible supported objects; without gap uses text size. Retains manual gaps; REMOVE clears both. Referenced-object movement/deletion updates gaps at render time. Up to 1000 sources, 128 automatic gaps and 100000 primitive pairs; excessive requests fail atomically. Other dimensions are supported using their styled lines/arcs and manual gaps. Their automatic gaps, labels and markers are excluded to avoid recursive or cyclic evaluation. Block-reference obstacles are resolved from transformed children, including nested blocks and local dimensions (maximum depth 16); hidden child layers are excluded.

name: DIMSPACE
description: Space selected unlocked parallel linear dimensions or concentric angular dimensions. Input: [distance in metres|AUTO] [BASE dimensionId]. The base is the first selected ID unless explicit. It remains unchanged. On each side of the base, dimensions are ordered by existing distance and spaced evenly; zero aligns them. AUTO uses twice the largest selected text size. Keeps sources, values, custom text placement and styles; rejects mixed/nonparallel/nonconcentric or invalid inward radii atomically. One undo step. POINT [BASE dimensionId] starts a snapped point pick with live preview: gap is the perpendicular distance from the base dimension line, or radial distance from its arc. Coordinate input and MCP point actions are supported; a numeric distance or AUTO also completes this stage. Escape cancels without edits.

name: DIMTEDIT
description: Place selected unlocked dimension labels independently of the measured geometry. No input (or POINT) starts a snapped interactive point with live preview; point actions and coordinate input commit, Escape cancels. POSITION x y sets the world position in metres; ANGLE degrees sets the text angle (displayed upright); HOME resets position and angle to automatic. Preserves label content, measurement, style and associativity; atomic and undoable.

name: DIMEDIT
description: Edit the label of selected unlocked dimensions without changing their measured geometry. Input NEW "text" replaces the label; <> inside the text expands to the current formatted measurement (including symbols/tolerances/alternate units). HOME restores the automatic label. ROTATE degrees sets the label angle. OBLIQUE degrees sets the world angle of extension lines on linear dimensions; OBLIQUE AUTO restores perpendicular extensions. Parallel extension directions and non-linear selections are rejected atomically. Text is bounded to 16384 characters. Inspection labels/rates are retained; updates are atomic and undoable.

name: DIMDISASSOCIATE
description: Detach selected unlocked dimensions from their sources without changing their current measured geometry, IDs or style. No input. Linear/angular/ordinate dimensions retain native defining points; radius/arc-length/center marks retain a bounded local curve snapshot. Sources can then change or be deleted independently. One undo step.

name: DIMREASSOCIATE
description: With no input, pick a new source in the canvas (or supply point actions with targetId); angular dimensions accept an arc or two intersecting line picks. Escape cancels without edits. Associate selected unlocked dimensions to input source entity IDs: one compatible curve or two intersecting line IDs for angular dimensions. All selected dimensions must support the supplied source(s). Replaces detached snapshots and former links, retaining style and placement parameters; validates atomically and commits one undo step.

name: DIMUPDATE
description: Apply the current dimension style (or input a quoted style name/ID) to selected unlocked dimensions, resetting their overrides in one undo step. Geometry/associations remain intact.

name: DIMREGEN
description: Refresh selected unlocked dimensions from their linked styles, preserving overrides and validating geometry. With no selection, process all editable model dimensions. No input. Refreshes block bounds; one undo step.

name: DIMINSPECT
description: Set an inspection frame on selected unlocked dimensions. Input: ON ["label" ["rate"]] or OFF. Label/rate maximum 256 characters. Keeps geometric associations; stored as a format override and undoable.

name: DIMSTYLE
description: Named dimension styles. No input opens the style panel and lists styles. RENAME "old" "new" preserves the style ID. SAVE "name" copies the selected dimension or current style; CURRENT "name" selects a style; APPLY "name" applies it to selected unlocked dimensions; DELETE "name" removes an unused inactive custom style. SET "name" TEXT|ARROWSIZE|GAP|OVERRUN metres, ARROW tick|closed|open|none, PRECISION 0..8, PREFIX|SUFFIX "text" edits a style and refreshes linked model/nested dimensions while preserving overrides. SET also accepts TOLERANCE none|symmetric|deviation|limits; TOLUPPER/TOLLOWER nonnegative metres (radians for angular dimensions), TOLPRECISION 0..8; ALTERNATE ON|OFF, ALTUNIT m|cm|mm|in|ft, ALTPRECISION 0..8; INSPECTION ON|OFF, INSPECTLABEL/INSPECTRATE text (256 characters maximum). Geometry and associations are retained; one undo step.

name: ATTEXT
description: Export model block attributes, including nested occurrences, to CSV or lossless JSON. Input: [CSV|JSON] [ALL|SELECTED] [TO "absolute path.csv/json"]. Defaults: CSV ALL, native save dialog or browser download. Includes hidden, invisible, constant and locked instances; selected scope traverses selected model roots. CSV strings are protected against spreadsheet formula execution. No drawing/history changes; close BEDIT first.

name: BATTMAN
description: Manage block attribute definitions. No input or a block name opens the Blocks palette; expand Attribute manager. Input: "block name" TAG TAG|PROMPT|DEFAULT "value", CONSTANT|INVISIBLE ON|OFF, or UP|DOWN|DELETE. Renaming migrates every reference value, including nested/locked instances, in one undo step. Defaults preserve existing variable values; constants update. Duplicate tags and broken dependencies are rejected. Close BEDIT before changing definitions.

name: ATTDEF
description: Define an attribute as native text in the current model or BEDIT draft. No input opens the definition form in the Blocks palette. Input: TAG "default value" x y [HEIGHT metres] [PROMPT "label"] [CONSTANT] [INVISIBLE]. Tags are unique within the current definition, uppercase, 1–64 letters/digits/underscore/hyphen starting with a letter. Select the created text together with geometry when running BLOCK. One undo step.

name: ATTEDIT
description: Edit a field on selected unlocked block references. Input: TAG "value"; constants and missing tags reject the entire operation. Without input opens selection properties. Each insertion has its own values. One undo step.

name: ATTSYNC
description: Synchronize attribute values of references to a named block (optional quoted name or ID), or to blocks identified by selected references. Preserve existing values by tag, initialize new fields, refresh constants and remove obsolete fields. Includes nested references; locked model references are unchanged. One undo step.

name: ATTDISP
description: Set attribute display to NORMAL, ALL (alias ON), or OFF. NORMAL respects invisible definitions; ALL reveals them; OFF hides all attribute values. Affects block rendering and snapping, including printing. One undo step.

name: WBLOCK
description: Export a local .lcad block library. Input: [name|LIBRARY|SELECTION] [TO "absolute/file.lcad"]. Empty input exports selection or the whole drawing relative to BASE. Named definition export includes nested definitions and resources; LIBRARY includes all named definitions. With no TO path opens Save As. Does not replace the active document. Close BEDIT first.

name: BLOCKIMPORT
description: Import reusable blocks from a .lcad library or ordinary drawing. Optional absolute path; otherwise opens a file chooser. Merges definitions, assets, layers and text styles without replacing model entities, resolving name/ID conflicts. One undo step. Ordinary drawings become a block relative to their BASE. INSERT FILE [path] imports then starts insertion of the first entry. Close BEDIT first.

name: BASE
description: Set the document insertion base point in metres. Input: x y, or omit input to pick/type a point. Does not move geometry. One undo step; Escape cancels. Close BEDIT first.

name: BEDIT
description: Open an isolated editable draft of a block. Input is a block name or ID (optional quotes); without input select one unlocked reference. Regular drawing commands, local selection and undo/redo operate on its local children. The saved document/autosave remain unchanged until BSAVE or BCLOSE SAVE. Draft content/assets are exposed in editor.blockEdit; document remains the saved model. Nested editing and replace_document are refused until BCLOSE.

name: BSAVE
description: Validate and save the current block-edit draft, updating every reference in one model undo step while keeping the editor open. Stable IDs, nested bounds, new resources and styles are retained. Cycles or broken child dependencies leave the draft open and the model unchanged. Resets the local undo baseline after a successful save.

name: BCLOSE
description: Close the block editor. Input SAVE (default) validates/applies the draft first; DISCARD abandons changes since the last BSAVE. A failed save leaves the editor open. Escape cancels only the active drawing command, not the edit session. Closing returns selection to model references.

name: BSEARCH
description: Open the reusable block palette. Optional input filters named definitions by case-insensitive name substring. The palette can create a block from the selection and start interactive insertion.

name: BLOCK
description: Create a named reusable block from the selected unlocked entities and their dependencies. Input: "name" [baseX baseY] [KEEP] [REDEFINE]. Omit coordinates to pick/type the base point; omit input to enter a name first. By default converts the source selection to one reference at the same position. KEEP retains source entities. REDEFINE updates an existing definition without changing its ID and refreshes all reference bounds. Cycles, locked dependencies and conversion that would break outside associations are rejected. One undo step; Escape cancels.

name: INSERT
description: Insert a named block on the active unlocked visible layer. Input: "name" [x y [positiveUniformScale [angleDegrees]]]. Names with spaces require quotes. Without coordinates, pick/type the insertion point with a preview; SCALE value and ROTATION degrees change the pending transform. ATTRIBUTE TAG "value" sets a pending variable attribute before placement, with preview and a single insertion undo step. The Blocks palette also offers values for the next insertion. No input prompts for the name. Native child geometry and linked resources are retained. One undo step; Escape cancels.

name: TRANSPARENCY
description: Apply an object transparency override (0 opaque through 90 percent transparent) to selected unlocked entities, including reference images. Requires one numeric value; one undo step. Source image alpha and per-image opacity are retained.

name: IMAGEATTACH
description: Attach a linked image in native Tauri. Input is an absolute source path (spaces allowed, optional quotes); omit it for a native file dialog. Supported PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/SVG, maximum 25 MiB and 64 megapixels. Creates one image with a cached embedded snapshot in one undo step. No automatic disk reads on opening a drawing.

name: IMAGE
description: Select one unlocked image. Without input opens the shared image editor. LINK or RELINK [absolute path] replaces its source, or opens a native dialog if omitted. RELOAD reads the linked source explicitly. EMBED removes the link, retaining its last snapshot. Native source reads are bounded; failure leaves the old image intact. Identity, placement, rotation, opacity, crop and colour adjustments survive reload; undo restores source and snapshot. Browser mode supports inspecting cached snapshots and EMBED.

name: WIPEOUT
description: Create a white masking polygon above existing entities without deleting them. Selected sources must form one simple closed straight-edged contour. Without selection or input POINTS, point actions/typed x,y append 3..128 vertices with preview; Enter/DONE commits, UNDO removes the last vertex, Escape cancels. FRAME ON/OFF changes selected editable masks; the shared panel also controls the frame. Masks are native closed point polylines with wipeout metadata, transform/clipboards/archive normally, and use DRAWORDER for stacking. The frame is included in print when enabled.

name: DRAWORDER
description: Reorder selected editable model entities. Input FRONT (default), BACK, FORWARD or BACKWARD; ABOVE/BELOW then require a point action targeting another visible entity via targetId or hit-testing. Selected and unselected relative order is stable. Locked/hidden entities cannot move. Escape cancels reference picking; effective changes use one undo step and persist in the entity array.

name: TEXTTOFRONT
description: Bring all editable text and/or dimension annotations to front, preserving relative order. Input TEXT, DIMENSIONS or ALL (default). Does not require a selection. One undo step only if order changes.

name: IMAGECLIP
description: Select one unlocked image. Open its shared crop editor or use RECT x1 y1 x2 y2, POLYGON x y ..., ON, OFF or DELETE. Coordinates are local image fractions 0..1. A simple nonempty polygon with 3..128 vertices is required. Sources are unchanged; crop follows image transforms, affects rendering/selection/snapping, and persists through clipboard/archive/PDF. One undo step.

name: IMAGEADJUST
description: Select one unlocked reference image. Open the shared image editor or apply BRIGHTNESS value or CONTRAST value (0..200, neutral 100), MONO ON/OFF, KEY #rrggbb [tolerance 0..100], KEY OFF, or RESET. Keying compares original 8-bit RGB channels before colour adjustments; tolerance bounds the difference on each channel. Edits are nondestructive per-entity adjustments, preserve embedded source bytes, and use one undo step. Model/layout rendering, clipboard SVG and PDF output retain the adjustments.

name: REGION
description: Create one independent region from selected closed curves or unbranched closed chains; sources are preserved. With no selection or input PICK, use a point action or x,y input to detect a bounded area and its immediate islands. Native loops define an even-odd planar interior. Supports move/rotate/scale/mirror, selection, clipboard, persistence and EXPLODE. Escape cancels a pending pick; creation is one undo step. Detection limits match HATCH PICK.

name: BOUNDARY
description: Pick an enclosed area using a point action or x,y input. Creates independent closed native polylines for the outer loop and immediate islands on the active visible unlocked layer, preserving source objects. Uses visible finite curves; rejects gaps, duplicate overlaps, edge picks and over-budget arrangements. Limits match HATCH PICK. One undo step; Escape cancels.

name: SELECT
description: Activate selection. Prefer the selection argument to select known entity IDs.

name: LINE
description: Draw connected line segments. Send point actions for vertices and Escape to end the chain.

name: XLINE
description: Create a persistent infinite construction line from an origin and a direction point. Two point actions commit one entity; Escape cancels an unfinished entity.

name: RAY
description: Create a persistent ray from its origin through a direction point. Two point actions commit one entity; Escape cancels an unfinished entity.

name: RECTANGLE
description: Draw a rectangle with corner, dimension, area, rotation, chamfer, fillet, or line-width options. In paper space, pick/type two corners in millimetres; creates an editable native paper rectangle.

name: HATCH
description: Create an associative hatch from selected closed curves or unbranched endpoint-connected curves. With no selection, or input prefixed PICK, pick an interior point (point action or x,y input). Escape cancels. Detection rejects open, overlapping or over-budget arrangements; capped at 256 input pieces, 2048 edges and 32768 samples. Input SOLID, LINES spacing angle, CROSS spacing angle, GRADIENT #rrggbb angle or RADIAL #rrggbb. Even-odd loops preserve islands. Maximum 512 native boundary parts. Selection is retained as source IDs; source edits refresh boundaries in the same history step.

name: HATCHEDIT
description: Edit one selected hatch in the shared panel. Accepts SOLID, LINES spacing angle, CROSS spacing angle, GRADIENT/RADIAL #rrggbb angle, ORIGIN x y, or DETACH. Pattern spacing and origin use metres. Locked hatches cannot be changed.

name: SOLID
description: Create a solid fill from the selected closed boundary curves, retaining source associations and islands.

name: GRADIENT
description: Create a gradient fill from the selected closed boundary curves. HATCHEDIT controls gradient type, end colour and angle; the start colour is the entity/layer colour.

name: HATCHTOBACK
description: Move selected hatches behind other drawing objects; with no hatch selected, moves all editable hatches. One undo step.

name: SPLINEDIT
description: Select one native cubic spline or all-cubic compound path. Opens its shared control-coordinate panel with a span selector. Optional CONTROL span control x y edits one control using one-based indices (controls 1..4) in one undo step. Connected joints move together; existing smooth tangent ratios are preserved. Locked objects cannot be edited. POINT index x y edits a retained fit point or B-spline vertex; KNOT index value edits a normalized parameter/knot (0..1). TANGENT START/END dx dy sets the endpoint derivative in metres per normalized parameter; FIT also accepts TANGENT START/END NATURAL. BEZIER discards the definition without changing geometry. CONTROL edits also detach it. INSERT index x y / REMOVE index change definition points and rebuild parameters. INSERTKNOT value refines CONTROL exactly. CONTROL with no arguments converts cubic spans exactly; FIT refits through span endpoints or an open point polyline (changes shape); POLYLINE tolerance converts to straight segments within tolerance in metres. Limits: 128 definition points, 4096 polyline vertices, depth 20. All indices start at 1.

name: SPLINE
description: Draw a cubic spline with FIT (natural chord-length interpolation, at least 2 points) or CONTROL/CV (clamped uniform B-spline, at least 4 control vertices). Point actions append up to 128 points; Enter or DONE commits exactly the clicked points as editable native Bezier spans plus their fit/control definition and normalized knots in one undo step. Escape discards the preview; changing mode restarts it.

name: ELLIPSE
description: Create an ellipse: AXIS uses two axis endpoints then a perpendicular radius point; CENTER uses centre, axis endpoint and radius point. ARC or CENTERARC adds start and end direction points. CW/CCW sets arc direction. Escape cancels; one completed ellipse is one undo step.

name: CIRCLE
description: Draw a circle using centre-radius, two-point, three-point, tangent-tangent-radius, or tangent-tangent-tangent construction.

name: POLYGON
description: Draw a regular polygon from its centre and radius, with a side count and inscribed or circumscribed mode.

name: ARC
description: Draw an arc using start-end-point-on-arc, start-centre-end, start-end-radius, or start-centre-angle construction.

name: TEXT
description: Create single-line text from a paper-space or model-space frame, then edit it in place.

name: MTEXT
description: Create a wrapping multiline text frame and open the rich in-place editor. In paper space, optional input is initial text, followed by two frame corners in millimetres; TEXTEDIT shares the model editor.

name: TEXTEDIT
description: Open the shared rich in-place editor for the selected model or paper-space text entity.

name: STYLE
description: Open the reusable named text-style manager.

name: CREATIONPANEL
description: Open shared sidebar properties for selected objects. Geometry, leader style/content, dimension and appearance controls reuse the creation panels; multiple selection exposes common appearance. Live edits are undoable.

name: PAN
description: Activate manual canvas panning.

name: ORTHO
description: Toggle persistent orthogonal point constraint, or pass 1/0 to enable/disable it. Shift temporarily inverts the current mode for point actions.

name: POLAR
description: Toggle polar tracking. Numeric input configures and enables it: the first value is the increment in degrees and remaining values are additional angles.

name: OTRACK
description: Toggle acquired object-snap tracking paths, or pass 1/0 to enable/disable them.

name: DSETTINGS
description: Open the drafting settings panel for polar angles and parallel, perpendicular, and tangent object-tracking relations.

name: TRACKPOINT
description: Acquire the next point as a temporary tracking origin without advancing the active drawing or modification command.

name: DYNMODE
description: Toggle in-canvas dynamic precision input, or pass ON/OFF or 1/0 to set it explicitly.

name: QUICKCALC
description: Evaluate a safe arithmetic and unit expression, optionally assigning a reusable session variable with name = expression.

name: LAYOUT
description: Open paper space, or create a layout from a named standard arrangement.

name: PAGESETUP
description: Open the active layout page-setup controls for paper, margins, and reusable profiles.

name: PSETUPIN
description: Import reusable page-setup profiles from another LUMCAD drawing.

name: PSETOUT
description: Export reusable page-setup profiles to a portable LUMCAD setup drawing.

name: MODEL
description: Switch from a layout to model space.

name: PSPACE
description: Switch to the active paper-space layout.

name: MVIEW
description: Open the active layout and create a rectangular viewport. Point coordinates use layout millimetres.

name: VPCLIP
description: Apply or edit a polygonal clip boundary on the selected layout viewport.

name: VPLAYER
description: Open per-viewport layer visibility and colour, linetype, and lineweight overrides.

name: VPMAX
description: Maximise the selected paper-space viewport for model navigation.

name: VPMIN
description: Return from a maximised viewport to the full paper layout.

name: OFFSET
description: Offset selected lines, construction lines, rays, polylines, rectangles, polygons, circles, arcs, or ellipses by distance or through a point, with erase/keep and destination-layer options. Ellipses produce adaptive cubic paths; singular inward offsets are rejected.

name: TRIM
description: Trim selected or visible curves. Pick a target portion, draw a cutting fence, or hold Shift on a target point to temporarily extend instead.

name: EXTEND
description: Extend the picked endpoint of a line, arc, or open path to the nearest valid boundary. Hold Shift to temporarily trim instead.

name: COPY
description: Copy selected entities from a base point to one or more destinations.

name: COPYBASE
description: Copy the selected geometry and its dependencies to the operating-system clipboard using a picked base point.

name: COPYCLIP
description: Copy the selected geometry and its dependencies to the operating-system clipboard.

name: CUTCLIP
description: Copy selected geometry to the operating-system clipboard and delete it only after the clipboard write succeeds.

name: PASTECLIP
description: Read supported LUMCAD or SVG geometry from rich or plain-text clipboard interchange and place it at a picked insertion point.

name: PASTEORIG
description: Paste LUMCAD clipboard geometry at its original drawing coordinates.

name: PASTEBLOCK
description: Paste supported clipboard geometry as one anonymous block reference at a picked insertion point.

name: MOVE
description: Move selected entities from a base point to a destination.

name: ROTATE
description: Rotate or copy selected entities around a base point using a pointer, configured numeric angle, or source/target reference directions.

name: SCALE
description: Scale or copy selected entities around a base point using a uniform factor, separate X/Y factors, or reference lengths.

name: MIRROR
description: Mirror selected entities across a two-point symmetry axis, with copy/replace and configurable text-glyph reflection.

name: ARRAY
description: Start an immediate rectangular array preview from selected entities with automatic spacing and default counts. Adjust BASE, XSPACING, YSPACING, COLUMNS or ROWS, then submit empty input to create; cancel to discard.

name: ARRAYPOLAR
description: Select a motif, pick or type the center, then edit a polar array preview. COUNT 1..100, ANGLE -360..360 (nonzero), ROTATEITEMS 0/1 and CENTER x,y adjust it. Full turns omit a duplicate last item; partial sweeps include both ends. Enter or ARRAYCLOSE commits. ARRAYEDIT reopens saved parameters.

name: ARRAYPATH
description: Select a motif then pick a separate connected curve/path (point action with targetId). COUNT divides its length evenly; SPACING fills it at a fixed metre interval (maximum 100 items). OFFSET, BASE, ALIGNITEMS 0/1, REVERSE and PATH edit the preview. Enter/ARRAYCLOSE commits; ARRAYEDIT reopens. Source path edits update the array in the same undo step. Moving only the array detaches its source while preserving editable parameters.

name: ARRAYEDIT
description: Select one rectangular, polar or path array to edit its saved parameters with the same preview as its creation command. Enter or ARRAYCLOSE commits one undoable edit; Escape cancels. Keeps the array entity ID.

name: ARRAYCLOSE
description: Commit the current array creation or edit preview. Send as input while ARRAY or ARRAYEDIT is active.

name: BREAK
description: Break a picked line, arc, circle, or path between two points while preserving native curve parts.

name: BREAKATPOINT
description: Split a picked open curve at one point without removing an interval.

name: STRETCH
description: Stretch the control points captured by a crossing window from a base point to a destination.

name: LENGTHEN
description: Lengthen or shorten the picked end of an open line, arc, or path by delta, percent, total, or dynamic value.

name: JOIN
description: Join endpoint-connected lines, arcs, ellipses, splines, or paths into one exact ordered mixed path.

name: EXPLODE
description: Explode selected compound paths, blocks, hatches, text, or dimensions into editable parts.

name: XPLODE
description: Explode selected compound objects with explicit per-part or parent property handling.

name: ALIGN
description: Align selected objects from two or three source/destination point pairs, with optional uniform scaling.

name: FILLET
description: Create a tangent radius fillet between picked curve branches, including zero-radius cleanup and polyline or multiple modes.

name: CHAMFER
description: Create a bevel between picked curve branches using two distances or distance and angle, including polyline or multiple modes.

name: BLEND
description: Create a cubic spline blend tangent to the picked endpoints of two open curves.

name: DIMENSION
description: Create an adaptive associative dimension or a free dimension between two points.

name: DIMLINEAR
description: Create a horizontal or vertical linear dimension independent of the measured segment angle.

name: DIMALIGNED
description: Create a linear dimension aligned with the measured segment.

name: DIMROTATED
description: Create a linear dimension along a typed rotation angle in degrees.

name: DIMANGULAR
description: Dimension the angle of an arc, two selected lines, or three picked points.

name: DIMARC
description: Create an associative length dimension for a selected or picked circular or elliptical arc. The value follows the source curve; the position grip adjusts annotation offset.

name: DIMRADIUS
description: Create a radius dimension for a circle or arc.

name: DIMDIAMETER
description: Create a diameter dimension for a circle or arc.

name: DIMJOGGED
description: Create a jogged-radius dimension for a circle or arc.

name: DIMORDINATE
description: Create an X or Y ordinate dimension from the drawing origin.

name: QDIM
description: Create a continuous series by default, or use QDIM BASELINE FIRST/LAST, for the selected dimensionable entities in one undoable operation.

name: DIMBASELINE
description: Create a baseline series from selected linear geometry or dimensions; append FIRST or LAST to choose the reference end.

name: DIMCONTINUE
description: Create continued chain dimensions from selected linear geometry or dimensions.

name: CENTERMARK
description: Create an associative centre mark on a selected or picked circle or arc.

name: DELETE
description: Delete the selected editable entities.

name: UNDO
description: Undo the latest document change.

name: REDO
description: Redo the latest undone document change.

name: SAVEAS
description: Open the native Save As dialog for the active drawing.

name: NEW
description: Create a new blank drawing, or TEMPLATE to choose a .lcad template, or FROM "absolute/template.lcad" in native Tauri. A template may be any ordinary .lcad drawing. Retains content, resources, settings, layouts and internal IDs but creates fresh document identity and dates with no destination path. Native reference paths are pinned beside the template; unresolved browser paths are reported. Save As protects the native template source from overwrite. Normal current-drawing save flow applies; cancelled/failed reads preserve the active session. Close BEDIT/REFEDIT first.

name: OPEN
description: Open the native .lcad file chooser.

name: PLOT
description: Open the plot preview for the active layout with area, scale, margins, style, and quality controls.

name: PDF
description: Preview and write the active layout directly to a deterministic PDF file. EXPORT PNG|JPG|JPEG|SVG followed by image export options exports the visible model instead.

name: PDFALL
description: Preview and write every layout, including mixed paper sizes, as one ordered PDF.

name: PDFSELECTED
description: Preview and write the currently selected layout tabs as one ordered PDF.

name: PUBLISH
description: Open the multi-layout publication preview for all layouts. Use SHEETSET PDF|DWFX [absolute/output path] to publish the open multi-drawing sheet set in its explicit order; default SHEETSET format is PDF. Saved sources are reread and preflighted before rendering.

name: AUTOPUBLISH
description: Publish all layouts without a dialog to a PDF beside the saved .lcad drawing.

name: DWFXOUT
description: Preview and publish all layouts as a multi-sheet DWFx/XPS package.

name: ZOOM
description: Set a relative zoom factor using a numeric command input.

name: EXTENTS
description: Fit all visible drawing content in the canvas.

name: POINT
description: Activate persistent point creation. Each picked or typed coordinate creates one native point on the current layer; Escape exits. Points expose NODE snaps and a position grip, and retain their symbol/size through save, clipboard, transforms and undo.

name: DDPTYPE
description: DDPTYPE symbol size sets the default point style and updates selected editable points (all editable model points if selection is empty). Symbols: dot, cross, x, circle, square, circle-cross, square-cross. Size is in metres, 0.000001 through 1000000. Undo restores defaults and existing points. Per-point style is editable in Properties.

name: DIVIDE
description: DIVIDE count [BLOCK "name" [ALIGN ON|OFF] [SCALE factor]] [REVERSE] places independent points or block insertions at equal arc-length intervals along one selected finite curve/path. Open paths exclude endpoints; closed paths include the seam once. Count: 2..10000. With no selection, pick the source; omitted parameters are requested interactively. Source is retained, results undo as one operation.

name: MEASURE
description: MEASURE spacing [BLOCK "name" [ALIGN ON|OFF] [SCALE factor]] [REVERSE] places points or block insertions at fixed physical arc-length spacing in metres. Starts one spacing from the source origin and excludes the final endpoint. Maximum 10000 placements. Select or pick one source, enter spacing, and Undo as one operation. ALIGN defaults ON and SCALE defaults 1.
